source.go_outbound_request_test: conduit/llm/transformer/openai/audio_outbound_test.go::TestOutbound_BuildSpeechRequest (L34-71, same newAudioOutbound config; asserts exact URL and absence of a 'stream' key)
source.note: End-to-end TTS round trip driven by one coherent Go test: client JSON {model tts-1, input Hi, voice alloy} -> unified speech request -> outbound POST .../v1/audio/speech -> provider returns binary audio/mpeg -> unified Speech{Audio,ContentType} -> client receives the identical bytes. Binary bodies cannot be body_json; they are recorded as body_bytes_hex (lowercase hex of the exact Go byte literal). llm.SpeechResponse.Audio and .ContentType are json:"-" fields (carried out-of-band), so unified_response.speech serializes as an empty object; the byte content is asserted via the hex transcript. selected_channel is null (no llm.Channel constructed).

inbound_http._comment: clientBody = json.Marshal(map{model:'tts-1', input:'Hi', voice:'alloy'}) with Content-Type application/json (L275-282). No Method/URL set by the Go test.

unified_request._comment: llm.Request from SpeechInboundTransformer.TransformRequest. Asserted in TestAudioInboundTransformer_Speech 'valid request' (richer fixture) and by this round trip via the outbound leg; stream==false because stream_format is absent (subtest 'missing stream_format stays non-streaming' L127-139). request_type/api_format constants asserted at audio_inbound_test.go L39-40.

outbound_http._comment: buildSpeechRequest output. Round trip asserts URL HasSuffix '/audio/speech'; TestOutbound_BuildSpeechRequest with the identical config (BaseURL 'https://api.openai.com', key 'sk-test') asserts the exact URL, Method POST, RequestType 'speech', APIFormat 'openai/audio_speech', and that the wire body has NO 'stream' key. Accept '*/*' for non-SSE speech and bearer auth come from audio_outbound.go buildSpeechRequest L60-84. Body fields with omitempty (response_format/speed/instructions/stream_format) are absent for this fixture.

upstream_http._comment: Simulated provider reply from the round-trip test (L290-296): StatusCode 200, Content-Type audio/mpeg, Body = []byte{0xDE, 0xAD, 0xBE, 0xEF} (binary, transcribed as lowercase hex).

client_http._comment: Final client response. Round trip asserts clientResp.Body == the provider audio bytes and Content-Type 'audio/mpeg'; StatusCode 200 asserted by the inbound 'response binary passthrough' subtest. The intermediate unified llm.Response carries Speech{Audio: 0xDEADBEEF, ContentType: 'audio/mpeg'} (asserted by TestOutbound_TransformSpeechResponse for the same shape).
